text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало takes first place in a
spectacular
victory to end the year and
solidify her position
as the star of her
generation!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just before her winning concert begins,
she
receives a call from her mother. This
time, King
Halo is calm.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She tells her mother that she'll surpass
her,
declaring that one day her legacy
will simply
become "Кинг Хало's mother"
instead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало leaves her phone with me and
runs off
to perform the concert. After
listening to both of
them speak, I realize
how they're both similarly
awkward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
